liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds it too short, though it offers intricate ensemble playing; Reviewer calls the album version anemic but respects it as the seed of later versions [4][8][10]
- **Stella Blue** (3 reviews): Reviewer was moved to tears by the Stella Blue on this tape; Compares well with live performances, with studio-quality mixing and vocals, yet not over-produced [2][4][10]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed Let It Grow and its transition into Row Jimmy [12]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer names Row Jimmy among personal highlights, alongside Weather Report Suite [9]
- **WRS Part 1** (1 review): Reviewer considers Weather Report Suite Bob's best work [8]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away** (1 review): Reviewer considers it the weak spot of the collection [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [14]
- **Let Me Sing Your Blues Away**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 8 archived performances [14]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Let it Grow, WRS Part 1 [14]

## The recordings

- **gd73-08-xx.sbd-wotf.davef.2522.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 69 min; rated 4.13/5 by 31 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard quality superb and crisp, with rare versions of favorite material; Reviewer notes funky keyboards, nice vocals and a classic sound; Reviewer describes the sound as very clean and sweet [2][3][12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Donna's singing and the harmonies sound especially strong in this period [8]
- Uploader says these are Wake of the Flood outtakes, with the month and date uncertain and a best guess [1]
- Reviewer thinks these versions are likely among the final mixes before the album was assembled [3]
- Reviewer rates the album as nearly as emotionally satisfying as American Beauty or Workingman's Dead [5]
- Reviewer says the album shows more artistic range than Workingman's Dead or American Beauty [10]
- Reviewer says this is a favorite studio release, made three years after American Beauty and free of Warner Bros contract [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-08-xx.sbd-wotf.davef.2522.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Betty Cantor reels transferred to PCM, then DAT, then DIO 2448, then SHN, via Dave F [1]
